summary: Code review completed for 3 bug fixes: 1) Create Deal panel styling now matches PropertyIntelligencePanel (position: fixed, right: 0, width: 500px), 2) ContactFormPanel now slides in from right (right: 500px when open) instead of left, 3) Edit Full Details button navigates to /deals/:dealId (not /workspace/deals/:id). All fixes verified through code review. Cannot test authenticated pages without Supabase credentials.

create_deal_panel_styling.details: Create Deal panel now uses position: fixed, right: 0, width: 500px, matching PropertyIntelligencePanel styling. Background, backdrop-filter, border, and box-shadow all match.

contact_form_panel_positioning.details: ContactFormPanel now positioned at right: 500px when open (was left: 500px). This places it adjacent to PropertyIntelligencePanel which is at right: 0. Panel slides in from right side.

edit_full_details_navigation.details: Edit Full Details button navigates to /deals/${data.id} which matches the route in App.js (deals/:dealId). Previously was navigating to /workspace/deals/:id which was non-existent.

pipeline_integration.details: Pipeline.js uses PropertyIntelligencePanel component. handleViewDeal navigates to /deals/${deal.id}. handleOpenPanel opens the side panel.

landing_page.details: Landing page loads correctly with DealLinked branding and Get Started button

login_page.details: Login page loads correctly with email/password inputs

critical_code_review_comments: MapView.js Create Deal panel (lines 1420-1434): Now matches PropertyIntelligencePanel styling - position: fixed, right: 0, width: 500px, same background/border/shadow
ContactFormPanel.js (line 283): Changed from left: 500px to right: 500px - panel now slides in from right adjacent to PropertyIntelligencePanel
PropertyIntelligencePanel.js (line 2619): Edit Full Details navigates to /deals/${data.id} - correct route
Both panels use zIndex 1050 (PropertyIntelligencePanel) and 1040 (ContactFormPanel) for proper layering
